announcements.title: Notice of Special Membership Meeting - August 20, 2026
announcements.body:
Dear Owners,

Attached please find the official notice for the Special Membership Meeting to
be held on Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 10:00 AM in the Building I Recreation
Room, immediately followed by the Board of Directors' Meeting. Both meetings
will also be available via Zoom.

The sole purpose of the Special Membership Meeting is to vote on a proposed
$2,500,000 revolving line of credit to fund the accelerated balcony
waterproofing project.

The attached packet includes the full meeting notice, agenda, background
information on the proposed line of credit, a Limited Proxy with Ballot, and a
Voting Certificate (required only for units with multiple owners, to designate a
single authorized voter). If you are unable to attend in person, please complete
and return the enclosed proxy as early as possible to help us establish a quorum
and tabulate votes.

This same packet is also being sent to all owners via physical mail this week,
including a return envelope for the completed Proxy and, if applicable, the
signed Voting Certificate.

Sincerely,

Ian Wilbraham, President
By Order of the Board of
Directors
